title: Quiet Cabin and Smooth Ride
summary: Reviews in this topic primarily praise the G60 for a quiet cabin, smooth driving feel, and overall ride comfort across multiple powertrains.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe a quiet interior or engine and often pair that quietness with smoothness, comfort, or an easygoing ride experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples use the word stays for unrelated meanings such as charging-item retention or preventing rolling, so they do not clearly express sentiment about quietness or ride quality.

limitations: The sampled fragments are heavily concentrated on short remarks about quietness and comfort, so finer distinctions such as road noise versus engine noise are only sparsely evidenced.
Some undetermined fragments appear because the keyword stays also matches unrelated topics, which makes this cluster slightly noisy.
Examples are limited to the provided sampled fragments and are not representative estimates of all G60 reviews.
